findings.summary: input_commit, subject_commit, and implementation_subject_commit are byte-identical (all bb44376bae9fcf9d2590760a09ccff82c1468e0c), satisfying the contract's same-commit requirement. Product consistency between work_head_commit 59751c0fc30dfe0a22f34c0f040529c70838b382 and the subject commit could not be mechanically verified via git diff (read-only inspection only), but file inspection shows the materialization commit stacks only reserved .dev-dispatch/ namespace metadata (the implement handoff JSON) on the product tip, consistent with a compliant metadata-only materialization; the deterministic seal independently verifies HEAD.

The rework resolves both prior final-review (rf-e034e413) blockers. (1) The generation-2 ORDER_VIOLATION is fixed: _walk (dd_replay.py:337) now walks through continuous and final review stages when their receipts are present and valid, so a replayed candidate whose inherited chain ended APPROVE-final carries its reviews forward rather than opening a fresh continuous-review attempt. The _final_replays probe (dd_replay.py:476) allows the walk to continue past a missing continuous intent when the final review is itself replayed, preventing the truncation to [configure, implement] that caused the prior ORDER_VIOLATION. (2) The prefix-ending-at-implement blocker is fixed by the _ends_at_implement + _inherited_entries + new_attempt_is_legal guard (dd_replay.py:206-218), which reads the committed feedback index and declines replay entirely when the inherited chain did not end in REJECT, so the carrier never sees an illegal new attempt. The fail-closed _select (dd_replay.py:288) without fallback to divergent partial prefixes preserves requirement 4. Regression coverage includes test_a_fully_reviewed_chain_replays_through_to_acceptance (test_dd_replay.py:410), test_a_final_approve_chain_with_only_a_missing_continuous_intent_replays_through (test_dd_replay.py:459), test_the_new_attempt_rule_mirrors_the_carrier (test_dd_replay.py:660), and test_a_partial_prefix_is_declined_when_the_inherited_chain_did_not_end_in_reject (test_dd_replay.py:680), satisfying spec requirement 5 including the complementary assertion.
